description: Per-operation-class inventory of the 120-file aligned CNC corpus used in 5-fold file-level CV (files enumerated in audit/file_fold_assignment.csv). Operation class = aligned-recording filename prefix (strip _<run>_aligned.csv).

definitions.n_files: distinct aligned recordings of this class used in CV
definitions.n_gcode_rows: sum over the class of distinct G-code instruction lines (CSV column gcode_line) covered by each recording
definitions.n_aligned_samples: sum of aligned 4 Hz sensor rows across the class
